profile.headline: Mobile Software Engineer at Meta, ex-Googler
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 17 years of industry experience and 11 years of extensive Android mobile development; Providing technical leadership on various aspects of modern Android development; Building security solutions to consumers on mobile platforms

Expertise
Mobile Applications, System Architecture, Multithreading, Application Security, Cross-platform development (Flutter), Java, Kotlin

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
WhatsApp Core Consumer AI Team
Synergizing Meta's leading GenAI technologies with the most widely used messenger app to build an awesome experience for users live in the future.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description:
Google Assistant (Driving Mode)
Create a single, unified mobile experience across Google apps on Android to provide users an intuitive, safer way to get around, keep in touch, and stay entertained while driving

positions.title: Sr. Principle Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Leading the development of the flagship mobile product - Norton Mobile Security (N360) on Android
Invented, designed and implemented Norton AppLock with Android Accessibility to provide another layer of app protection (Java)
* Created feature based architecture which decoupled development across different teams, and applied to multiple Norton consumer products
* Implemented security engine integrations by driving cross team communication with backend teams and engine vendors
* Driving and implementing cross-platform solutions using Flutter for mobile platforms (Dart)
* Driving and implementing technical integration with Norton back-end services
* Coaching teams for best practices of Android development and writing apps in Kotlin

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing mobile client side apps and integrating them with Norton backend services.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing mobile security products for Norton consumer products including anti-malware, anti-spam, anti-theft.

Innovate an online device sharing project for developer/QA.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Security research, design and development for Windows Mobile 5.x/6.x security products including firewall, anti-virus, encryption.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on implementing minor releases of security product on Windows Mobile.
• Worked on designing and implementing several security products.
• Created automation tool to create product patches by interacting with internal server.
• Created internal website to let team member review product requirement easily.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Trend Micro Mobile Security 2.0 and 3.0 on Windows Mobile 2003 and 5.0.
• Responsible for customization and bug fixing to get our products preinstalled on several mobile manufactures' devices from Korea and Taiwan.

projects.title: MobEx
projects.description: MobEx is a remote device sharing service for Android to help developers to use a remote Android device completely as a local one not only for normal usage, but also for debug purpose, just like a local emulator! It's in development, but awesome!
